messages:
Ana (Product): Quick follow-up from today's leadership Q&A: a few concrete asks so teams can act. 1) Where should we bias investment among Hosted/Dedicated/Private over the next 12 months? 2) What's the single-sentence sales signal for Dedicated? 3) How do we crisply position vs cloud AI platforms and self-hosted inference vendors?

Jordan (CEO): TL;DR: mission unchanged 1Make predictable, economical LLM inference for dev teams. Investment bias: Hosted = top priority for growth/PLG + fastest iteration; Dedicated = productize for mid-market & enterprise (higher ARPU); Private = strategic focus for regulated customers. All get runway, but resources tilt to Hosted first.

Sahil (Eng): To confirm: "tilt to Hosted" means we won't deprioritize Dedicated infra fixes, right? Need to know for planning.

Jordan (CEO): Correct. Hosted improvements should be upstream-first where possible. Dedicated gets parallel stability and SLA workstreams. We won't freeze Dedicated roadmap1just stagger major new features.

Priya (Sales): For sales messaging I need a short, memorisable line we can use on calls. Can you give a tight sentence?

Jordan (CEO): Use: "Redwood gives teams consistent, high-performance LLM inference across hosted, reserved, and private deployments—so you get predictable latency, clear unit economics, and enterprise controls without rebuilding the stack."

Ana (Product): Practical signal for Dedicated outreach? Spend threshold, qps, or security req?

Jordan (CEO): Primary signal = sustained monthly spend above placeholder $25k/mo; secondary = sustained peak QPS above shared pool SLOs or explicit security/regulatory asks. Revenue Ops will set final thresholds.

Sahil (Eng): Positioning vs competitors: how direct should we be with cloud providers who offer model+infra vs inference vendors who sell open runtimes?

Jordan (CEO): Be factual: highlight our unified runtime across deployment modes, cost controls (batching, caching, quantization recommendations), and reliability w/ graceful fallbacks. Versus cloud providers: emphasize operational predictability and vendor-agnostic model catalog. Versus inference vendors: emphasize managed, observable experience and SLA-backed operations. No public antagonism.

Priya (Sales): Copying that into the playbook. I'll create two one-liners: developer-focused and CIO-focused.

Ana (Product): Action items: I'll update the roadmap to show Hosted as highest growth bet while scheduling Dedicated milestones. Sahil: please propose 3 engineering SLO targets for Hosted/Dedicated parity (p50/p95 latency, cost/token, cold start) by EOD Wed. Priya: update playbook with Jordan's line and draft signal thresholds. Jordan: confirm the $25k placeholder?

Jordan (CEO): Confirmed as working placeholder. We'll refine with Revenue Ops.

OpsBot: Recording and slides uploaded: https://redwood.internal/recordings/2365024001 1 notes in the shared drive.

Sahil (Eng): Will sketch targets and post in the roadmap ticket.

Priya (Sales): Will ping for review when draft playbook is ready.

Ana (Product): Thanks everyone. Leave any follow-ups here.
